content.text: The excerpt combines several narratives. In the North West, Cameron and Mandy aid an injured Piegan boy, investigate Indigenous conspiracies in the Sun Dance Canyon, and confront rebellion. Cameron patrols reserves, captures Eagle Feather and Copperhead, and survives an ambush; outlaw Raven saves a cattle herd but dies protecting others. The Mounted Police help suppress the 1885 rebellion, while Cameron’s loyalty preserves Blackfeet allegiance. At the Big Horn Ranch, Dr. Martin realizes Moira loves Smith, then remains after learning Smith is merely leaving to marry elsewhere. The text then shifts to a critique of Osteopathy, attacking exaggerated claims, quackery, advertising, and fraudulent cures while defending rational physiotherapy. Later travel chapters describe visits through Cornwall, including Tintagel and Boscastle. A children’s story follows Colonel Freddy’s Zouaves from Camp McClellan back to New York. Finally, John Smith’s inheritance scheme resolves when he returns as Stanley G. Fulton and becomes engaged to Maggie Duff.
